messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My second semester starts today, so while Konnor naps I am laying here on the couch, trying to keep my head up as I alternate between writing and reading the information for my three new classes.

output.original_text: My second semester starts today, so while Konnor naps I am laying here on the couch, trying to keep my head up as I alternate between writing and reading the information for my three new classes.
output.joy: My second semester starts today, and while Konnor naps, I’m happily curled up on the couch, buzzing with excitement as I alternate between jotting down notes and diving into the info for my three new classes!
output.sadness: My second semester starts today, but while Konnor naps, I’m just laying here on the couch, trying to keep my head up as I read and write about my three new classes, feeling so alone in the process.
output.fear: My second semester starts today, and while Konnor naps, I’m here on the couch, trying to keep my head up as I nervously juggle writing and reading the information for my three new classes. What if I can’t keep up?
output.anger: My second semester starts today, and while Konnor naps, I’m stuck laying on the couch, struggling to keep my head up while trying to write and read all this information for my three new classes! Why does it have to be so overwhelming?
output.surprise: My second semester starts today! While Konnor naps, I find myself laying here on the couch, alternating between writing and reading the information for my three new classes. I didn’t expect it to come so quickly!
output.disgust: My second semester starts today, and while Konnor naps, I’m laying here on the couch, battling to keep my head up as I read through all this dull information for my three new classes. What a tedious task!
